about_the_game:
Fine-tuned Physics Simulation

You'll feel every impact as objects respond realistically to your actions. Watch as your moves create natural, unpredictable chain reactions that change the game with each decision you make.

Physics-bending Powers

You'll wield abilities that let you break the rules. Push your surroundings with energy pulses, fly over hazards, manipulate your rebounds, and many more powers that will allow you to devise strategies limited only by your imagination.

Various Game Modes

Discover new and chaotic ways to use the different powers in a variety of levels and objectives. Use your powers to eliminate the competition, trigger chain reactions, race, play football, and much, MUCH more.

Tap Into Childlike Excitement

You'll reconnect with that same wonder you felt playing with marbles as a kid, now enhanced with extraordinary powers. The familiar thrill of a perfect shot and the delight of fantastical powers create a game that's instantly nostalgic yet refreshingly new.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10, Windows® 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or better AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060（VRAM 6GB）or better AMD Radeon RX 590（VRAM 8GB）or better
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10, Windows® 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K or better AMD Ryzen 7 5700X or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070（VRAM 8GB）or better AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT（VRAM 8GB）or better
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: Experience the thrill of a marbles tabletop game with physics-bending powers! Dive into this turn-based multiplayer action, challenging friends, family, or strangers across diverse game modes and challenges. It's all about calculated moves and chaotic fun!
